pack.battlefield1.name: §4The Chronicles of the Trenches GunPack
pack.battlefield1.desc: §4In the midst of the raging flames of war, the good and evil of human nature, the preciousness of friendship, and the ruthlessness of war are demonstrated one by one. Through the eyes of the soldiers, you will witness the most real and cruel aspect of war and experience those trench tales that have been sealed by the passage of time.
